diagram_previews.alt: Top view: three blue circles of radius 6 with centres at the vertices of a grey dashed equilateral triangle of side 12, and a small red circle at the centre of the triangle, with a dashed segment from its centre to one big centre.

Vertical cross-section: a big blue circle of radius 6 and a small red circle of radius r resting on the plane P and touching each other. The dashed segment between the centres is labelled 6 + r; grey dashed legs of a right triangle are labelled 4 root 3 (horizontal) and 6 - r (vertical).
